notes.title: Prologue 1.3.15 Patch Note
notes.notes: [p]Hello Master of Piece players, this is I M GAME.[/p][p]Since the release of the Prologue, we’ve received a tremendous amount of valuable feedback from players.[/p][p]Among them, we selected the issues that required the most urgent improvements and reflected them in this update.[/p][p]Feedback that has not yet been addressed will be implemented gradually during Early Access, so we look forward to your continued opinions and feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700250/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]System Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Mercenary movement using Action Points has been adjusted from “unlimited” to “adjacent 1 tile.”[/p][/*][*][p]4x3 and 4x5 battle tiles have been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards for street battles have been changed from “Trait Rewards” to “Mercenary Rewards.”[/p][/*][*][p]The building event “Inn” has been changed to “Trait Shop.”[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI / UX Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]You can now claim rewards in building events and post-battle victory screens by clicking on the target.[/p][/*][*][p]When selecting rumors at the Tavern, one of the three must now always be assigned to a mercenary.[/p][/*][*][p]When enhancing traits, you can now preview the enhanced trait without placing a mercenary.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Difficulty Adjustment[/h3][list][*][p]Hardship Stage 2[/p][list][*][p]Before: Boss health increases.[/p][/*][*][p]After: Boss health and [b]attack[/b] increase.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balance[/h3][list][*][p]Traits[/p][list][*][p]Riposte[/p][list][*][p]Before: When you survive after being hit, counterattack and deal damage equal to your remaining health. Gain +1 health if this counterattack defeats an enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]After: When you survive after being hit, counterattack and deal damage equal to your remaining health.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Preemptive Defense[/p][list][*][p]Before: Before the ally’s flag is attacked through an empty tile, move in front of the enemy attacking the flag and gain +2 health at the end of the round.[/p][/*][*][p]After: Before the ally’s flag is attacked through an empty tile, [b]move in front of the enemy attacking the flag and gain +2 health. (Max 4)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Restoration[/p][list][*][p]Before: At the end of each round, gain +1 health. If you took damage in the previous round, gain an additional +1 health.[/p][/*][*][p]After: At the end of each round, gain +1 health. [b](Max 4)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fighting Spirit[/p][list][*][p]Before: When you survive after taking damage, gain +1 attack and +1 health.[/p][/*][*][p]After: When you survive after taking damage, gain [b]+1 attack.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Lifesteal[/p][list][*][p]Before: Whenever an enemy mercenary is killed, fully restore lost health.[/p][/*][*][p]After: [b]Once per battle,[/b] when killing an enemy mercenary, fully restore lost health.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Resentment[/p][list][*][p]Before: While on the battlefield, gain +1 attack each time you or an ally takes damage.[/p][/*][*][p]After: While on the battlefield, [b]gain +1 attack each time another allied mercenary takes damage.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Relics[/p][list][*][p]Guardian’s Emblem[/p][list][*][p]Before: At the end of each round, all allies recover 1 lost health.[/p][/*][*][p]After: At the end of each round, 1 random ally recovers 1 lost health.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo 1.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings to all of our Master of Piece fans!

Today, we present the 1.2.0 update notes, which include bug fixes discovered after the 1.1.0 update and system improvements.

[b]Windows[/b]
[General]
• Added borderless window mode to graphic settings.

[b]Common[/b]
[Gameplay]
• Added new patterns for elite battles and boss battles.
• Improved the UI to display mercenary upgrade stages more intuitively.
• Adjusted the ‘Holy Book’ relic and ‘Preemptive Defense’ trait.

[Bug Fixes]
• Fixed minor issues related to Japanese fonts.
• Fixed a bug where the game switched from fullscreen to windowed mode upon restart.
• Fixed a bug that prevented progress when using the Turkish language.

Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below!

notes.title: Demo 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings to all of our Master of Piece fans!

Today, we are pleased to present the 1.1.0 update, which address issues discovered after the 1.0.3 patch. This update includes fixes for reported issues, as well as improvements based on your feedback to enhance the overall gameplay experience.

[General]
• Added French, German, Spanish, Russian, and Italian (temporary translations).
• Improved performance to ensure the game runs smoothly in the background.

[Gameplay]
• Added a cost system in battles. 
• The cost system now allows players to change the positions of mercenaries deployed during battles.
• Improved the boss battle logic to ensure that no mercenaries are left unused.
• Corrected the information displayed for upgrades at the Shaman’s Hut.
• Modified the system to allow players to select which mercenary will receive random positive rumors.
• Improved the layout of some UI elements for a more intuitive screen design.
• Ensured that even empty traits and rumor slots are displayed in the mercenary info UI.

[Bug Fixes]
• Fixed a bug where the Enter key did not work correctly when set as a shortcut.
• Fixed a bug where the trait 'Combat Readiness' and the relic 'Iron Cross' was activated before the first round of battle.
• Fixed a bug where some relic effects obtained through card events did not activate.
• Fixed a bug where drag-and-drop mercenary deployment during battles did not function correctly.
• Fixed a bug where battle items could not be obtained in the bookstore.
• Fixed a bug where graphic settings changed on its own.

Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below!

notes.title: Demo 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings to all of our Master of Piece fans!

We have fixed additional issues identified since the last patch.

[b]Common[/b]
[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where the BGM does not play.

[Gameplay]
- We've slightly softened the difficulty of boss battles and elite battles.

Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below!

notes.title: Demo 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings to all of our Master of Piece fans!

Since we released the demo last week, we've had a lot of people play our demo.
We'd like to thank everyone who has played the demo.

Your reviews after playing are always very helpful!

Today we're happy to share the 1.0.2 patch notes, which include bug fixes and improvements we've found since last week.

[b]General[/b]
[General]
- Optimized the file size (down to 700MB!)

[Gameplay Improvements]
- Added a reminder popup that double checks your action if you leave without taking the battle reward.
- Added an in-game line to indicate that not selecting any rumors will be irreversible.
- Added an in-game line to remind players that if they select a mercenary with a rumor in a saloon, the existing rumor will be lost.

[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where the tile effect 'fog' was not visible.
- Fixed a bug that occurred when selecting 'Abandon Journey' at the end of a battle.

Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below!

notes.title: Announcement for Demo release delay
notes.notes:
Greetings to all of our Master of Piece fans.

We are sorry to announce that our demo will be delayed for a few days, due to Steam build review procedures. 

We apologize for the delay, and we will be back when the demo is ready.

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: 2025 Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Happy New Year![/h2]

Greetings to all of our Master Piece fans, hope you have a wonderful 2025 ahead! 

As we have showcased our game through CBTs and game festivals in 2024, we were overwhelmed by the love and support you have shown for our Master Piece. We are deeply grateful for all the interest and feedback towards our game, and it is what empowers us to continue working on the game we love so much.

This year, while we focus on adding new features and polishing the game in various aspects, we would also like to show more of what is going on inside the devs. Devlogs and new content will be frequently released, and any kind of feedback from you is deeply appreciated.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/9a97870ce124e66a5ebc12da66cd7118f2b83b9f.jpg[/img]


Here’s the Roadmap 2025, and we proudly announce that 

[h2]Master Piece will be released on Early Access during the First half of this year! (Hopefully…🙏)[/h2]

A new Demo will be released during Q1 too. Please enjoy and leave us reviews and feedbacks. They really help!

Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below! 

Thank you.
